description: Returns one rulebook rule in full: plain statement (he/en), conditions, method, exceptions, law (with section where verified), values in force with their official sources, worked examples computed by the engine, related forms, guides and tools, and a Markdown card ready to quote. Use the id from find_rules (e.g. "labor.severance", "tax.credit_points", "form.101", "fact.wage_delay").
name: get_rule
title: Get an Israeli rule with its law and sources
